record.oneLiner: A massive, robust diplodocid sauropod of the Morrison Formation.
record.description: Apatosaurus was a large, robustly built diplodocid sauropod from the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation of North America. It had a long neck, a whip-like tail held above the ground, and stockier, heavier bones than its relative Diplodocus. It was a browser that likely held its head elevated.

notableFacts.text: Stockier and more robustly built than its relative Diplodocus.
Its whip-like tail may have been cracked to make loud sounds.
Averaged 21–23 m; some individuals may have exceeded 30 m.
